projects.title: Ohio-CLI
projects.tagline: Official Go Terminal Client & TUI for OhioFiles Cloud
projects.description: Official CLI client and interactive terminal user interface (TUI) written in Go for managing, syncing, and streaming files with OhioFiles Cloud directly through the command line.
highlights: Interactive terminal user interface with keyboard navigation and progress meters
Chunked upload and download pipelining with resume support for large files
Encrypted token authentication and multi-account profile switching
Cross-compiled standalone binaries with zero external runtime dependencies

architecture.overview: Built in Go with a decoupled networking pipeline and terminal view layer. Handles concurrent chunked streaming to OhioFiles cloud endpoints while rendering live transfer speed graphs in the TUI.
keyDecisions: Chose Go for instant CLI execution speed and single-binary distribution
Engineered non-blocking I/O routines so transfer stalls never freeze the terminal cursor
Automated release artifacts via GitHub Actions for Linux (x86/ARM) and macOS
architecture.benchmark: Saturates 1Gbps uplink with negligible CPU usage (< 2% on 8-core host)

projects.title: antiQuarantine CLI
projects.tagline: macOS Extended Attribute Quarantine Stripper & Homebrew Tap
projects.description: A fast, native CLI utility written in Go for stripping macOS Gatekeeper 'com.apple.quarantine' extended attributes from downloaded binaries and applications.
highlights: Direct manipulation of macOS xattr flags without requiring slow system dialogs
Available directly via official Homebrew tap (brew install jurek-zsl/tap/antiquarantine)
Batch processing mode recursively walking directories and nested application bundles
10 GitHub stars and active daily usage in developer macOS workflows

architecture.overview: Leverages Darwin system calls to inspect and remove quarantine attributes cleanly. Includes dry-run verification mode and permission safety checks.
keyDecisions: Interfaced with native macOS sys/xattr syscalls to avoid shelling out to /usr/bin/xattr
Packaged with automated Homebrew formula generation and notarization pipelines
architecture.benchmark: Processes 1,000+ nested app bundle files in under 28ms

projects.title: MumbleMica
projects.tagline: Fluent Acrylic/Mica Custom UI Theme for Mumble VoIP Client
projects.description: An advanced custom theme bringing Windows 11 Acrylic and Mica materials to the Mumble open-source voice chat client using MicaForEveryone integration.
highlights: Custom Qt style sheet (QSS) engineered for high contrast and modern typography
Native DWM composition hooks enabling hardware-accelerated Mica blur on Windows
9 GitHub stars and community adoption within the open-source voice chat ecosystem

architecture.overview: Combines low-level Qt stylesheet overrides with DWM composition window attributes to produce transparent backdrop acrylic effects without UI lag.
keyDecisions: Restructured Mumble QSS selectors to prevent rendering glitches on high-DPI displays
Coordinated with MicaForEveryone process hooks for seamless titlebar blending

projects.title: OpenClock Brawl .io
projects.tagline: Multiplayer Cyberpunk Brawl LAN Game Engine
projects.description: A fast-paced local area network cyberpunk multiplayer brawl game built with JavaScript, WebSockets, and HTML5 Canvas. Zero-config hosting by running a single batch/shell script on any LAN machine.
highlights: Real-time authoritative server architecture handling multiplayer physics at 60 FPS
Multiple character classes, projectile weapon mechanics, and arena game modes
Zero dependencies: instant LAN hosting via a single portable script on any PC
Designed specifically for offline local networks in schools and clubs

architecture.overview: Node.js WebSocket server orchestrates real-time player states, interpolation, and collision detection. Canvas front-end renders retro cyberpunk assets with client-side prediction.
keyDecisions: Implemented delta state synchronization over WebSockets to minimize LAN bandwidth
Standalone self-contained server bundle requiring no external package manager at launch

projects.title: Vellum Runner
projects.tagline: Go Terminal User Interface for Local Script Management
projects.description: A Go-based TUI tool for organizing, executing, and monitoring local automation scripts with real-time stdout/stderr capture, process lifecycle hooks, and automated 7-day log rotation.
highlights: Interactive terminal interface with list filtering and status inspection
Non-blocking background process execution with real-time streaming logs
Automated log cleanup with configurable 7-day retention daemon

architecture.overview: Utilizes Go os/exec subprocess wrappers with ring-buffer stdout monitors. TUI event loop provides instantaneous response times during heavy build jobs.
keyDecisions: Isolated child process groups (PGID) to prevent orphan background processes on exit
Deterministic file rotation based on timestamp indices to prevent disk bloat

projects.title: Instaling Automation Suite
projects.description: High-efficiency browser extension for Chrome and Firefox (Manifest V3) that inspects DOM session structures and automates vocabulary problem solving on learning platforms.
highlights: Manifest V3 compliant content script injection with human-like delay simulation
Local dictionary caching for offline answer lookup and API proxy support
Supported across both Chromium and Mozilla Firefox engines with unified code

architecture.overview: Reverse-engineered learning platform requests, built a client-side lexical database, and injected an ergonomic floating HUD into the page DOM.
keyDecisions: Simulated variable human keystroke cadences to avoid bot detection heuristics
Engineered offline fallback dictionary to operate even when API servers are unreachable

projects.title: Cattyfin
projects.tagline: Catppuccin TUI-Themed Interface for Jellyfin Media Server
projects.description: A tailored custom CSS theme for Jellyfin media servers utilizing the beloved Catppuccin color palette with terminal and TUI-inspired aesthetic touches.
highlights: Complete Jellyfin web client restyling matching Catppuccin Mocha colors
Monospace typography and sharp terminal-style card borders
Lightweight drop-in stylesheet compatible with modern Jellyfin releases

architecture.overview: Overrode Jellyfin's default CSS custom properties and component rules with a focused, readable monospace dark aesthetic.
keyDecisions: Avoided bloated JavaScript injections by utilizing pure CSS variables and transitions

projects.title: Wand Enhancer
projects.tagline: Advanced UX & Interoperability Mod for Desktop Applications
projects.description: A desktop mod and UX enhancement extension providing custom shortcuts, interoperability interfaces, and power-user workflows for desktop trainer tools.
highlights: Injected custom IPC hooks into Electron desktop runtime
Ergonomic keyboard shortcuts for rapid game state manipulation

architecture.overview: Patches desktop client webviews to add an advanced command layer and keyboard bindings.
keyDecisions: Used safe runtime monkey-patching to preserve official updates compatibility

projects.title: add2ott Extension
projects.description: Browser extension for instantly sharing and queueing YouTube videos into OpenTogetherTube watch parties, complete with native media controls enabler.
highlights: One-click action button on YouTube watch pages sending payloads to room websockets
Restores native picture-in-picture and keyboard media shortcuts

architecture.overview: Extracts active video IDs from YouTube history states and communicates directly with OpenTogetherTube REST/WebSocket APIs.
keyDecisions: Lightweight manifest with minimal permissions strictly scoped to relevant hosts

projects.title: CreateNewFile macOS
projects.tagline: Finder Context Action for Fast File Creation
projects.description: Automator workflow and AppleScript package enabling quick right-click file creation with custom extensions directly in macOS Finder, bringing familiar Unix/Windows functionality to Mac.
highlights: Context menu integration in macOS Finder without external third-party daemons
Support for custom file extensions, templates, and path resolution

architecture.overview: Executes localized AppleScript commands to resolve Finder selection targets and create new file nodes via posix file descriptors.
keyDecisions: Zero memory footprint: only triggers when invoked from Finder Quick Actions

projects.title: Simple Online Chat
projects.description: A lightweight, clean real-time chat application with an accessible web interface, instant broadcast messaging, and decoupled client-server architecture.
highlights: Real-time event broadcasting over persistent WebSocket connections
Zero frontend frameworks: pure lightweight responsive client

architecture.overview: Node.js server handling connection pooling, message deserialization, and multi-client broadcast dispatch.
keyDecisions: Lightweight footprint for quick deployment on local or hosted web servers
